paper_title: Search for invisible axion dark matter of mass ma = 43 µeV with the QUAX–aγ experiment
notes: 90% C.L. upper limit on axion-photon coupling measured at cavity frequency νc = 10.40176 GHz corresponding to axion mass ma = 43.0182 µeV. Minimum sensitivity (best limit) is gaγγ < 0.766 × 10^-13 GeV^-1 achieved in a small mass window of 3.7 neV around 43.0182 µeV. Data collected in ~1 hour of operation. Limit curve extracted by visual inspection of Figure 5 (observed 90% C.L. upper limit shown as blue shaded region). Assumes local dark matter halo density ρa ≈ 0.45 GeV/cm³. Cavity details: Cu cavity V = 80.56 cm³, cooled to ~200 mK, immersed in 8.1 T magnetic field, coupled to Josephson parametric amplifier at SQL.
